arms.placebo@4: control: a random training-instruction pair at lambda 4

metrics.code: factor_hooks.code_for: base = the readable same-scene sibling with the same relation, object factor = (the base with the task's object, the base), gated to the approach (gripper open) unless 'all'
metrics.decision: go to the pre-registered 30-49 read only if the best composition arm reaches >= 10 of 70 successes and beats both cfg@4 and placebo@4 by >= 5 of 70; otherwise composition of object words is stopped on pi0.5 and the fold (factor tokens) is the main line
metrics.episodes: 10 per arm and task, practice init states 0-9, light recordings with every object's pose; zero-shot reference from zc_bind's own-instruction runs
metrics.why: zc_bind: object words are read in LIBERO-Object layouts 0.43 of the time (neither >= 0.7 nor <= 0.3) and not in living rooms (non-habit objects 0.0-0.1); zc_probe failed its validity gate (LIBERO-Goal first-chunk pointing 0.43 < 0.8) but its contrast cosines were +0.72 in Goal and +0.5-0.7 in the living rooms; so the pre-registered branch is the composition pilot
